Chatterjee Residence

Complete First-Floor Home Interior – Entrance, Living, Kitchen, Dining & Four Bedrooms

A 2,500 sq.ft. first-floor home interior in Gangarampur, from a carved-wood main door and a Buddha console in the living room to a glossy black kitchen, a fluted dining wall and four bedrooms, each with its own palette and a signature backlit feature wall.

Location
Indranarayanpur Colony, Gangarampur, West Bengal
Area
Approx. 2,500 sq.ft.
Type
Residential Interior
Style
Contemporary Luxe
Year
2024
Client
Asim Chatterjee
About

Designed for Asim Chatterjee in Indranarayanpur Colony, Gangarampur, this project covers the complete first floor of an independent house: around 2,500 sq.ft. of entrance, living, kitchen, dining and four bedrooms.

The home opens with a timber-wrapped entrance and a carved wood-finish main door, with a Panchmukhi Hanuman relief in a lit niche above. Inside, the living room is calm and light, organised around a Buddha console, while the kitchen and dining area pair glossy black units with a green marble table and a lit fluted wall.

Each of the four bedrooms has its own identity: copper leaf, green wave, walnut jaali and stone geometric. All four share floating beds with LED bases, backlit feature walls behind the bed and full-height built-in storage, so the home feels varied but consistent.

A Carved-Wood Arrival
The entrance lobby is wrapped in warm timber panelling, with vertical slats framing a sculpted wood-finish main door, a frosted glass sidelight and a long brass pull handle. Above the door, a lit niche holds a Panchmukhi Hanuman relief, and a floating square pendant lights the way in.
A Calm Living Room
The living room centres on a seated Buddha on a floating console, set against a soft patterned backdrop between walnut pilasters and lit by suspended timber spotlight batons. A marble-look TV wall with open display shelving faces an ivory sofa and a sculpted glass coffee table.
Kitchen & Dining
The U-shaped kitchen pairs glossy black base units with light upper cabinets and a stone backsplash. Next to it, the dining area has a green marble table with copper legs, a lit fluted wall, brass leaf art and a timber-slat ceiling.
The Study Bedroom
A copper leaf-pattern glass panel, framed by a curved LED cove, rises above a tufted grey headboard. A floating study desk with a lit bookshelf, a two-tone wardrobe with an open lit niche and a floating bed with an LED base complete the room.
The Green Wave Bedroom
Curved deep-green panels sweep across leaf-print wallpaper behind the bed, echoed by an S-curve backlit wardrobe panel and a slatted timber ceiling. A built-in study desk sits below a sculpted wavy shelf.
The Walnut & Jaali Bedroom
Twin backlit jaali panels frame the bed wall, and a full wall of bronze-tone panels between walnut battens wraps the room. Opposite, a full-height wardrobe in walnut and stone tones includes a flush door and a full-length mirror.
The Stone & Geometric Bedroom
A backlit patina panel with a geometric inlay sits above a quilted black headboard, next to a door clad in stone-finish panels with diagonal grooves. A two-tone stone wardrobe with a mirror finishes the darker, more dramatic palette of this room.
Highlights
Complete First-Floor Interior
Entrance, living, kitchen, dining and four bedrooms designed as one home.
Four Distinct Bedrooms
Copper leaf, green wave, walnut jaali and stone geometric themes.
Backlit Feature Walls
Every bedroom has a lit signature panel behind the bed.
Built-In Study Desks
Floating desks with lit shelving are integrated into two bedrooms.
Carved Main Door & Prayer Niche
A sculpted wood-finish door with a lit Panchmukhi Hanuman niche above.
Layered Lighting
Cove lines, downlights, floating bed bases and backlit panels throughout.
